categories.name: Agents that do the work
categories.description: AI agents prepare the work across leads, deals and cases. A person approves every step.

features.title: Lead scoring
features.description: Agents score every lead and account, and show the reasons behind each score.

features.title: Drafted follow-ups
features.description: For every deal going quiet, an agent drafts the next email for a person to approve.

features.title: One approval queue
features.description: Six kinds of AI work land in one queue, each with what the agent noticed and where it looked.

features.title: 15 agent types
features.description: Scoring, sentiment, churn risk, next best action and more. Customise what each one does for your team.

categories.name: Your pipeline and service
categories.description: One record of every deal, case and conversation.

features.title: Pipeline and forecast
features.description: The deal board, the list and the forecast are the same pipeline, with stalled deals flagged.

features.title: Cases and tickets
features.description: Cases routed, prioritised and summarised, with SLA timers and sentiment on every conversation.

features.title: Email and calendar
features.description: Compose, reply and book meetings without leaving the record.

features.title: Workflow automation
features.description: Build multi-step workflows, and extend the builder with your own node and action types.

categories.name: Connected and secure
categories.description: Works with the tools you use, with protection on from day one.

features.title: Six connectors
features.description: Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Stripe and PayPal, plus Google and Microsoft sign-in.

features.title: Approval and audit
features.description: No AI action goes out without a person's approval, and every change is written to an audit log.
benefits: Human approval on every AI action

features.title: Isolation and sign-in
features.description: Each workspace's data is kept apart, and multi-factor sign-in is available on every account.

features.title: Build on Aurora
features.description: Inbound and outbound webhooks, React hooks and a CLI. The TypeScript SDK is in beta and API keys are coming soon.

metadata.notes: Aurora features page. Every claim is one the product backs today: no metrics, certifications or SLAs.
